finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: If the executable path contains user-controlled data that includes shell metacharacters (like ; or |), it could lead to OS command injection.
finding.assumptions: The executable path might be influenced by user input or environment variables, which are not shown in the code.

parsed.refutation_attempt: 1) Checked that printf("%s") simply writes the string to stdout; it does not invoke a shell or interpret shell metacharacters. 2) Verified that the source is _NSGetExecutablePath which returns the absolute path of the current executable, determined by the OS, not by user input or an environment variable. 3) Confirmed there is no subsequent call to system(), exec*, or any command‑execution API that would use the contents of path. 4) No conditional or size check could influence this path usage because the only sink is a standard printf call.
